definitions.explanation: A person who works in government administration, especially high-ranking officials.
The system of government officials and their practices.

examples.japanese: {官僚|かんりょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧{官僚|かんりょう}
{官僚|かんりょう}⟦{主義|しゅぎ}→主義：03215_shugi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧{官僚|かんりょう}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}いた→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{政治家|せいじか}→政治家：03084_seijika⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{転身|てんしん}した→転身：14395_tenshin⟧。
examples.english: After working as a bureaucrat for many years, he switched careers to become a politician.

examples.japanese: {官僚|かんりょう}⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{改革|かいかく}する→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧。

{官僚|かんりょう}⟦{的|てき}な→〜的：09839_teki⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}すぎて→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦{申請|しんせい}→申請：04207_shinsei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: There were too many bureaucratic procedures, so the application took a long time.

notes:
{官僚|かんりょう} refers to government officials, especially career administrators in central government ministries. It can also refer to the bureaucratic system itself.

COMPOUNDS:
- {官僚|かんりょう}⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧: bureaucratic system
- {官僚|かんりょう}⟦{主義|しゅぎ}→主義：03215_shugi⟧: bureaucratism (often negative)
- ⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧{官僚|かんりょう}: high-ranking official
- {官僚|かんりょう}⟦{機構|きこう}→機構：02784_kikou⟧: bureaucratic apparatus
- {官僚|かんりょう}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧: bureaucratic (na-adjective)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{公務員|こうむいん}→公務員：01588_koumuin⟧: civil servant — broader term covering all government employees
- ⟦{役人|やくにん}→役人：12611_yakunin⟧: government official — slightly informal, sometimes negative
- {官僚|かんりょう} specifically implies elite career officials in national ministries

USAGE:
Often carries a negative connotation when used critically, suggesting rigid procedures, inflexibility, or self-serving behavior ({官僚|かんりょう}⟦{主義|しゅぎ}→主義：03215_shugi⟧).
